title: Worth Another Look:Constrained World-Model Planning for Visual Inspection
abstract: arXiv:2611.24187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual inspection in field robotics and environmental monitoring must localize multiple targets under strict compute and sensing caps. Exhaustive sweeps waste calls on absent classes, while myopic and search-free policies stumble over heterogeneous tariff cliffs or discard viewport edits whose value emerges only after re-querying. We formulate inspection over frozen detectors as neuro-symbolic observation planning under partial observability, decoupling a compact recurrent world model (WM) from exact symbolic feasibility and tariff rules. Receding-horizon beam search with online replanning jointly schedules class queries, crops, enhancements, and termination (stop), paired with slack-aware shadow pricing and legal fallback at larger budgets. Across eight terrestrial, optical, and sonar benchmarks, multi-step lookahead outperforms static schedules and search-free offline RL under tight budgets -- gaining up to 28.4 AP percentage points

translated_title: 值得再看一眼：面向视觉检查的受限世界模型规划
translated_abstract: 野外机器人学和环境监测中的视觉检查需要在严格的计算与感知预算限制下定位多个目标。穷举式扫描会在不存在的类别上浪费调用，而短视策略和无搜索策略则会卡在异构的费率陡坡上，或者丢弃那些只有在重新查询后才能显现价值的视口编辑操作。我们将基于冻结检测器的检查问题形式化为部分可观测性下的神经符号观测规划，将一个紧凑的循环世界模型（WM）与精确的符号可行性判定及费率规则解耦。带有在线重规划的滚动时域束搜索联合调度类别查询、裁剪、图像增强和终止决策，并配合感知松弛的影子定价以及在更大预算下的合法回退方案。在八个陆地、光学和声呐基准测试中，多步前瞻规划在紧张预算下优于静态调度和无搜索的离线强化学习——最高可获得28.4个AP百分点。
tldr: 该论文将冻结检测器上的视觉检查形式化为部分可观测下的神经符号观测规划，通过紧凑循环世界模型与滚动时域束搜索在线联合调度查询、裁剪、增强和终止，在严格预算下比静态调度和无搜索离线RL最高提升28.4个AP百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates visual inspection over frozen detectors as neuro-symbolic observation planning, using a compact recurrent world model with receding-horizon beam search and online replanning to jointly schedule queries, crops, enhancements, and termination, achieving up to 28.4 AP percentage points over static schedules and search-free offline RL under tight budgets.
